lines.text: Moving your TFSA to a better provider? Do it wrong, and you pay SARS a 40% penalty.
Lerato has R30,000 in a TFSA, and this year she's already added R20,000.
She withdraws the R30,000 and puts it in a new TFSA. To SARS, that's a new contribution.
That's R50,000 this tax year. The limit is R46,000. R4,000 over, at 40%, is a R1,600 penalty.
And withdrawals never give your R500,000 lifetime limit back.
The right way: ask the new provider for a TFSA transfer. It goes company to company, and doesn't touch your limits.
The full TFSA guide is on the channel.
So, moving your TFSA? Transfer it. Don't withdraw it.
